title: Root Knot Nematodes on Leafy Vegetables

Header: Root Knot Nematodes on Leafy Vegetables
Meloidogyne spp. Sinhala –“Moolagatithi Watapanuwa”; Tamil-“Ilai marakkarikalil ver mudichchu vilanku pulu”

Prevention: Choose a site with no history of the pest
Use nematode free tools and equipment
Deep plough during land preparation and expose to sunlight
Monitoring: Observe regularly the development of patches of yellowing plants with stunted growth
Check infested plants for root knots
Direct Control: Rate of dilution – 3.75 ml in 5 lit water for 10 sq.m
Rate of dilution – 1.25ml in 5 lit of water for 10 sq.m
Restrictions: Always wear personal protective equipment while handling pesticides.
Do not eat, smoke or drink while spraying pesticides.
Read the manufacturer’s instructions carefully before handling pesticides.
Do not repeat pesticides with same mode of action
Apply as a soil drench only in affected areas.
Apply as a soil drench only in affected areas.
